verdict.rationale: Codegen documents an official Python SDK, a thin wrapper over the Codegen API with the same capabilities, plus a concrete code example (`Agent(org_id, token)` and `agent.run(prompt=...)`). It is backed by an extensive REST API reference covering agent runs, logs, PRs, integrations and sandboxes. missing for 10: SDKs in languages beyond Python (only one SDK is evidenced), a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec for generating clients (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK working in practice.
